verdict.score_rationale: This lands on the 5 anchor because the topology is readable and regionally organized, but pervasive plain gray boxes, weak registry vocabulary, uneven density, and visible routing remnants keep it from reading as a finished pin-up.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: Large unexplained empty bands surround and separate the regions, especially below the upper-left flow and across the outer frame, while several containers are much larger than their contents require.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Colored region washes and route colors provide some discipline, but nearly every operational component is rendered as the same gray box rather than wearing registry-specific colors.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: Visible dangling line stubs appear above the response cache and to the right of the self-hosted pool, and several long routed wires meet or pass around nodes in ways that expose construction machinery.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Boxes are locally consistent and the numbered regions establish hierarchy, but sparse oversized containers, scattered notes, long connector runs, and plain boxes substituting for richer operational-map objects create an uneven, unfinished rhythm.
